'''Heavy Bombers''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Can spawn naturally, once a [[Colony]] with at least 10 points exists in the dimension, individually with a spawnweight of 1.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Heavy Bombers are Flying Tank, Bomber/Summoner Hybrid units with basic melee capabilities. They attempt to hover above the target and drop their bombs.

*Their Ranged Attack is performed by them releasing Bombs, which destroy blocks and spawn mobs.
**When these bombs explode, they summon an [[Overseer]], [[Vigilante]], [[Marauder]], or [[Monarch]]. 
**It will not use this attack if the target is above the ground.
*Heavy bombers will occasionally swoop down to hit their target with contact damage.
*Heavy Bombers can spawn [[Succor|Succors]].
*Heavy Bombers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 15, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 5 Blocks range.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Heavy Bombers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
